assessment: The article by Goedhoop et al. provides an important analysis of the role of terminal dopamine release in the nucleus accumbens in processing aversive events that will be of value to researchers interested in the neural mechanisms of reinforcement learning and computational modeling of dopamine function. Using a variety of conditions, the authors provide convincing data in support of the role of accumbal dopamine release in processing aversive events that situate the current report among growing interest and mounting investigations into the role of dopamine in aversion.
